message.content: {"caption":"Horizontal bar chart comparing evolved reward across eight knowledge types in Opus 4.8.","description":"The chart, titled “Opus 4.8: knowledge type,” plots evolved reward (%) on a horizontal scale from 0 to 100, with ticks at 0, 25, 50, 75, and 100. Eight bars are arranged from highest to lowest: data cleaning procedure (n=7), 85.7%; file format knowledge (n=17), 82.4%; mathematical method (n=28), 80.7%; library API usage (n=33), 79.2%; debugging heuristic (n=8), 70.0%; domain procedure (n=58), 69.2%; tool workflow (n=19), 68.4%; and evaluation protocol (n=3), 66.7%. All bars are blue except domain procedure, which is gold. A vertical dashed reference line labeled “89-task mean” is at approximately 69% reward; the first four categories are clearly above it, while the last three are at or below it, with domain procedure nearly coinciding with the line.
